findings.title: An empty --failed reason renders a blank did-not-run stanza
findings.description: advisor --check --failed "" passes an empty reason through to didNotRun, so advisor.md says the consult did not run and gives no reason at all.
findings.suggestion: Default an empty reason to a fixed phrase before rendering.

findings.title: advisor --brief <change> reads a flag-first change name as the flag's value
findings.description: --brief takes no value, but the flag parser hands the next token to it, so `interlock advisor --brief my-change` leaves no positional and requireChange resolves no change. The flag-first spelling the usage text allows fails where the positional-first one works.
findings.suggestion: When flags.brief is a string and no positional names a change, read it back as the change name.

findings.title: advisor --check exits non-zero instead of recording a consult that did not run
findings.description: Once the change resolves, advisorCheck still has two exits: readRawInput dies when the draft path is missing or unreadable (2384), and a failed writeFileSync of advisor.md calls die(err.message) (2402-2406). Both exit 1 with no advisor.md written, so the spec run stops at a consult the proposal calls advice, and nothing records that it did not run.
findings.suggestion: Read the draft in a try/catch and turn a read failure into status did-not-run with the reason; on a failed write, emit the check JSON with status did-not-run and written: false, and return 0.
